chunks: He said: Abu Ja‘far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa, from ‘Ali ibn al-Nu‘man, from ‘Amir ibn Ma‘qal, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, who said: Abu Ja‘far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon them both, said:

“O Abu Hamza, do not place ‘Ali below the level to which Allah has raised him, and do not elevate ‘Ali above the level where Allah has kept him. It is sufficient honor for ‘Ali that he will fight the people of the return and that he will pair off the inhabitants of Paradise.”

key_terms.أهل الجنّة: ahl al-janna (people of Paradise): The righteous believers destined for eternal reward
key_terms.الكرّة: al-karra (the return/rajʻa): A Shiʻa eschatological concept of a return to worldly life before the Day of Judgment
key_terms.غلوّ: ghuluw (extremism): Theological exaggeration beyond what the Imams permitted regarding their status

ai.seo_question: What is the proper station of Imam Ali according to Imam al-Baqir, and what are Ali's unique eschatological roles?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (AS) instructs Abu Hamza al-Thumali to maintain balance regarding the station of Imam Ali (AS): neither diminishing the rank to which God elevated him, nor exaggerating beyond what God appointed. He highlights two unique honors: Ali will fight the apostates in the rajʻa (return before the Day of Judgment), and he will pair off the inhabitants of Paradise. This teaching, delivered in Kufa where extremist Ghulat currents existed, directly addresses the early Shiʻa community’s need to uphold Ali’s divinely ordained status without falling into theological excess.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 6. He said: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali ibn Al-Husayn ibn Babawayh, may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from his father who reported from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from ‘Ali ibn al-Nu’man, from Amir ibn Ma’qal, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, that Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him) said:

"O Abu Hamza, do not place ‘Ali (a.s.) below the level to which Allah has raised him, and do not elevate him above the level where Allah has kept him. It is enough (excellence) for ‘Ali that he is the one who fought the apostates and he is the one who will pair off the inmates of Paradise."
